messages:
alex_support: FYI customer reported invoice token counts > dashboard for embeddings — only for batched requests. They provided a tiny repro and sample invoice lines.

alex_support: Paste from customer: 
`curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings 
 -H 'Authorization: Bearer $KEY' 
 -H 'Content-Type: application/json' 
 -d '{"model":"rwd-embed-v1","inputs":["short","","a very long input that gets truncated by our tokenizer","mid length"]}'`

alex_support: They said dashboard shows 3 input units billed, invoice shows 4. They batch 4 inputs in one request.

maria_billing: Noted. Does the invoice show per-input or per-token breakdown? Can you attach the invoice line items?

alex_support: Invoice line: `embeddings rwd-embed-v1 usage 0.0045 USD 4 units` (customer screenshot). Dashboard usage widget shows 3 inputs for that time window. Customer insists we undercount in dashboard or overcount in invoice.

sam_ml: Quick hypothesis: our meter pipeline currently expands batched inputs into per-item token counts, but we also have a separate fallback that counts the raw request payload tokens if any item is empty after trimming — could cause double-counting when an empty string is present.

alex_support: They do have an explicit empty string as 2nd input in the batch (see curl).

sam_ml: That aligns. Empty-string handling was special-cased in older code: we used to normalize empty inputs to a single blank token for model compatibility, then a subsequent step treats that as a separate meterable input; a recent change deduped empty inputs in dashboard aggregation but left invoice pipeline unchanged. So invoice=4, dashboard=3.

alex_support: Can you repro locally? Customer would like a credit if bug on our side.

sam_ml: Reproduced with unit test. Patch in branch: fix/embed-meter-empty-input dedupe. Repro test: 
```python
from rwd_tokenizer import count_tokens
batch = ["short","","a very long input that gets truncated by our tokenizer","mid length"]
counts = [count_tokens(x) for x in batch]
# prior behavior: counts = [2,1,10,3] -> invoice counts sum = 16, dashboard dedupe removed the empty -> 15
```

taylor_eng: I'll coordinate with billing infra. Minimal change: ensure invoice pipeline applies same empty-input dedupe step as dashboard aggregator and enforce per-input accounting order before any raw-payload fallback. Putting up a PR and will run billing reconciliation job for the last 72 hours to find affected invoices.

maria_billing: If we need to credit customers, run a query to find invoices where invoice_units - dashboard_units = 1 and request payload contained empty input in that time range. I can prepare a draft credit template once we have the affected list.

alex_support: Customer asked for repro steps and ETA. ETA for a patch?

sam_ml: Patch merged to staging in ~2 hours. If staging looks good I'll schedule deploy to billing-prod overnight (low usage window). Reconciliation job should finish within 4 hours after deploy.

alex_support: Thanks — I'll update the customer: we found mismatch caused by empty-input handling in batched embeddings, patch rolling to staging, will reconcile and credit if we overbilled.

billing-bot: Automated note: reconcile-job queued (job-id: rwd-recon-2026-03-17-001).

maria_billing: Also flagging for accounting: possible small cohort of charges in last 7 days. I'll prepare a list and a one-time credit pipeline.

taylor_eng: Follow-up - added telemetry event `embed.batch.empty_input_flag` to help quantify. Will attach counts to PR.

alex_support: Closing loop: customer replied with :thumbsup: and asked to be CC'd on credits. I'll loop them in once Maria has the list.
